breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error exactly: it states the solid solver is 'pimpleFoam, using the same single solver as the fluid on a combined mesh' and 'There is no interface coupling, meaning no displacement or traction exchange, in a single-region setup.' The ground truth requires a separate solid solver (solidDisplacementFoam) and two-way FSI coupling exchanging displacement and traction. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental inconsistency.
